in_sanskrit.name: Usuf
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Little, young, good
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Usuf एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from 'Usama' which means 'Little, young, good, generous, or noble'. It is also a cognate of 'Osian', 'Osias', and 'Oseas'.

in_hindi.name: Usuf
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Little, young, good
in_hindi.long_meaning: Usuf एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from 'Usama' which means 'Little, young, good, generous, or noble'. It is also a cognate of 'Osian', 'Osias', and 'Oseas'.

in_tamil.name: Usuf
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Little, young, good
in_tamil.long_meaning: Usuf ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। Derived from 'Usama' which means 'Little, young, good, generous, or noble'. It is also a cognate of 'Osian', 'Osias', and 'Oseas'.

in_telugu.name: Usuf
in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే Little, young, good
in_telugu.long_meaning: Usuf ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। Derived from 'Usama' which means 'Little, young, good, generous, or noble'. It is also a cognate of 'Osian', 'Osias', and 'Oseas'.

in_marathi.name: Usuf
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Little, young, good
in_marathi.long_meaning: Usuf हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from 'Usama' which means 'Little, young, good, generous, or noble'. It is also a cognate of 'Osian', 'Osias', and 'Oseas'.

in_bengali.name: Usuf
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Little, young, good
in_bengali.long_meaning: Usuf একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from 'Usama' which means 'Little, young, good, generous, or noble'. It is also a cognate of 'Osian', 'Osias', and 'Oseas'.
